parsed.rationale: Exact identifiers (claude-opus-4-7, gpt-5.5, gemini-3.1-pro-preview, deepseek-v4-pro, Hugging Face IDs) and release dates are given for evaluated models, and temperature 0 is stated. No harness tag or commit is tied to the reported numbers. Note: S4 example config sets the simulator agents to gpt-5.5, whereas S1 names DeepSeek-V4-Pro, and the evaluator model is not named in S1; code also does not send temperature by default.
